The '''Jubilant Bhartia Group''' is an Indian [[Conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]] with interests in pharmaceuticals, food services, agribusiness, energy, and other services.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Saraswathy |first1=M. |title=Q&A: Shyam S Bhartia, CMD, Jubilant Bhartia Group |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/economy-policy/q-a-shyam-s-bhartia-cmd-jubilant-bhartia-group-111111400086_1.html |website=Business Standard India |access-date=17 October 2021 |date=14 November 2011}}</ref> It was founded in 1978 by Shyam Sundar Bhartia and Hari Bhartia and is headquartered in Noida, Uttar Pradesh.

==History==
Brothers Shyam Sundar Bhartia (husband of [[Shobhana Bhartia]]) and Hari Bhartia founded Vam Organics Limited on 21 June 1978.<ref>{{cite web |title=Jubilant Pharmova Ltd. Company Profile & Executives |url=https://www.wsj.com/market-data/quotes/IN/XNSE/JUBLPHARMA/company-people |website=Wall Street Journal |access-date=17 October 2021}}</ref> The name was the abbreviation of the product the company manufactured, [[vinyl acetate]] [[monomer]] (VAM).<ref name = "BT">{{cite web |title=Five families show how business can thrive by working together |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine/corporate/story/family-business-thrive-in-india-fortis-religare-jubilant-139935-2014-11-20 |website=Business Today |date=20 November 2014 |access-date=17 October 2021 |language=en}}</ref> The business was seeded with funds obtained from their father Mohan Lal Bhartia, who was a steel wire and [[Rolex]] watch trader in [[Kolkata]].<ref name="Forbes"/><ref name = "BT"/> Vam Organics gained opportunities to carry out higher-value work for drug and chemical industries following [[economic liberalisation in India]] in the 1990s. The company was renamed Jubilant Organosys in 2001, which began the use of the name "Jubilant" for the group.<ref name="Forbes">{{cite web |last1=Shmavonian |first1=Karl |title=Pharma and Fast Food Fuel the Jubilant Bhartia Group |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbesasia/2012/10/24/pharma-and-fast-food-fuel-the-jubilant-bhartia-group/ |website=Forbes |access-date=17 October 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

On the recommendation of a friend who owned foreign pizza licences, the Bhartias entered into a master franchise partnership with [[Domino's Pizza]] in 1996 and established Dominos Pizza India Private Limited. The company changed its name to Jubilant FoodWorks in 2009.<ref name="Forbes"/>

The Jubilant Bhartia Group had revenues of over $3 billion in 2012.<ref name="Forbes"/>

==Companies==
The Jubilant Bhartia Group has four flagship companies - Jubilant Pharmova, Jubilant Ingrevia, Jubilant FoodWorks and Jubilant Industries - all of which are publicly listed. The Group's other businesses are registered as private limited companies.<ref>{{cite web |title=Overview |url=https://www.jubilantbhartia.com/about-us/overview |website=Jubilant Bhartia |access-date=18 October 2021}}</ref>

===Jubilant Pharmova===
Jubilant Pharmova is the Jubilant Bhartia Group's first company and was established in 1978.<ref name = "BT"/> The company was renamed Jubilant Organosys Limited in 2001,<ref name="Forbes"/> and '''Jubilant Life Sciences''' Limited in July 2010.<ref>{{cite web |title=Jubilant Organosys splits, changes name |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/business/jubilant-organosys-splits-changes-name/story-ysDeVkx8VMfdFvDuM0FnQL.html |website=Hindustan Times |access-date=17 October 2021 |language=en |date=8 July 2010}}</ref> Jubilant Life Sciences was demerged to Jubilant Ingrevia on 1 February 2021,<ref>{{cite news |last1=Market |first1=Capital |title=Jubilant Life Sciences renamed Jubilant Pharmova |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/jubilant-life-sciences-renamed-jubilant-pharmova-121020101566_1.html |website=Business Standard India |access-date=17 October 2021 |date=1 February 2021}}</ref> and Jubilant Life Science Limited was renamed Jubilant Pharmova Limited.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Market |first1=Capital |title=Jubilant Life Sciences renamed Jubilant Pharmova |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/jubilant-life-sciences-renamed-jubilant-pharmova-121020101566_1.html |website=Business Standard India |access-date=17 October 2021 |date=1 February 2021}}</ref> The company has 3 business segments; [[Medication|pharmaceuticals]], [[Contract research organization|contract research and development services]] (CRO), and proprietary novel drugs.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Company Profile |url=https://www.jubilantpharmova.com/about-us/company-profile |access-date=2022-07-04 |website=www.jubilantpharmova.com}}</ref> Jubilant Pharmova is also a contract manufacturer of sterile injectables, ophthalmics, otics and ointments (sterile and non-sterile), creams and liquids.<ref name=":4" /> The company has the second largest commercial [[Radiopharmaceutical|radio pharmacy]] network in the [[United States]] (US), and is the second largest company in the allergenic extract market in the US.<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |last1=Khandekar |first1=Siddhant |last2=Thakur |first2=Raunak |last3=Mehta |first3=Kush |date=8 February 2022 |title=Jubilant Pharmova (JUBLIF) |url=https://www.icicidirect.com/mailimages/IDirect_JubilantPharmova_Q3FY22.pdf |access-date=6 July 2022 |website=ICICI Direct |page=1 }}</ref>

===Jubilant Ingrevia===
The Jubilant Bhartia Group demerged its pharma and life sciences business, Jubilant Life Sciences Limited, to a new company called Jubilant Ingrevia Limited on 1 February 2021. The name Ingrevia is a portmanteau of the words "ingredients" and "life" (''vie'' in French).<ref>{{cite web |title=DEMERGER OF "LIFE SCIENCES INGREDIENTS" BUSINESS FROM JUBILANT LIFE SCIENCES LIMITED INTO A NEW ENTITY "JUBILANT INGREVIA LIMITED" |url=https://www.jubilantingrevia.com/pdf/vendor-communication-12Jan2021.pdf |website=Jubilant Ingrevia |access-date=17 October 2021}}</ref> Jubilant Ingrevia was listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange on 19 March 2021.<ref>{{cite web |title=Jubilant Ingrevia lists on the bourses today |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/jubilant-ingrevia-lists-on-the-bourses-today-8655321.htm |website=CNBCTV18 |access-date=17 October 2021 |language=en |date=14 October 2021}}</ref> The company is diversifed life sciences and chemicals company. The company's operations can be divided into three segments; [[speciality chemicals]], nutrition and health solutions and life science chemicals.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Sonavane |first=Ravindra |date=18 January 2022 |title=Rakesh Jhunjhunwala cuts stake in Jubilant Ingrevia by 0.81% |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/earnings/rakesh-jhunjhunwala-cuts-stake-in-jubilant-ingrevia-by-0-81-7952231.html |access-date=2022-07-04 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}}</ref> As of 2022, the  speciality chemicals contributed 33% of Jubilant Ingrevia's revenue, nutrition and health solutions contributed 18% and life science chemicals contributed 49%.<ref name=":2" />

As of 2022, Jubilant Ingrevia is the world's lowest cost producer of [[pyridine]]-based derivative products, one of the two producers of pyridine and a leader in 14 pyridine derivatives.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=30 April 2022 |title=Rating Rationale: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited |url=https://www.crisil.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/JubilantIngreviaLimited_April%2030,%202022_RR_293114.html |access-date=2022-06-30 |website=www.crisil.com}}</ref> The company is one of the two largest manufactures of [[vitamin B3]] globally, one of India's largest manufactures of [[vitamin B4]], one of the two largest producers of [[acetic anhydride]], and a large producer of [[ethyl acetate]].<ref name=":0" /> Jubilant Ingrevia also offers speciality grades of ethanol, for uses in the pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, [[personal care]], and [[Common ethanol fuel mixtures|fuel blending]] sectors.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Speciality Ethanol |url=https://jubilantingrevia.com/our-businesses/chemical-intermediates/speciality-ethanol |access-date=2022-07-03 |website=jubilantingrevia.com}}</ref> The company produces the ethanol from [[sugarcane]] [[molasses]].<ref name=":1" />

Jubilant Ingrevia also offers [[Contract manufacturing organization|contract development and manufacturing]] (CDMO) services to international innovator [[Pharmaceutical industry|pharmaceutical]] and [[agrochemical]] companies.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Speciality Chemicals |url=https://jubilantingrevia.com/our-businesses/speciality-chemicals/cdmo |access-date=2022-06-30 |website=jubilantingrevia.com}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite news |last=Capital Market |first= |date=18 April 2022 |title=Jubilant Ingrevia soars on winning Rs 270-cr CDMO contract |work=Business Standard India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/jubilant-ingrevia-soars-on-winning-rs-270-cr-cdmo-contract-122041800200_1.html |access-date=2022-07-01}}</ref> In 2022, the company signed a Rs 270 crore speciality chemicals CDMO contract with a top 10 globally leading innovator pharmaceutical company.<ref name=":3" />

===Jubilant FoodWorks===
{{main|Jubilant FoodWorks}}
Jubilant FoodWorks Limited is a [[food service]] company which holds the [[master franchise]] for [[Domino's Pizza]] in India, [[Nepal]], [[Sri Lanka]] and [[Bangladesh]], for [[Popeyes]] in India, Bangladesh, Nepal and Bhutan, and also for [[Dunkin' Donuts]] in India.

===Jubilant Industries===
Jubilant Industries was founded on 23 February 2007 as a private limited company. It was publicly listed on 16 March 2010.<ref>{{cite news |title=Jubilant Industries Ltd. |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/jubilant-inds-40342/information/company-history |website=Business Standard India |access-date=17 October 2021}}</ref> It is a [[specialty chemical]] company that manufactures [[agrichemicals]], [[polymers]], [[adhesives]] and [[latex]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Jubilant Industries to sell its liquor license |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/jubilant-industries-to-sell-its-liquor-license-120112400141_1.html |access-date=13 November 2021 |work=Business Standard India |date=24 November 2020}}</ref>

===Jubilant Enpro===
Jubilant Enpro Private Limited (JEPL) was established in 1992.<ref>{{cite web |title=Jubilant Enpro Private Limited Featured Employer Profile |url=https://www.rigzone.com/jobs/featured_employer.asp?e_id=14151 |website=www.rigzone.com |access-date=17 October 2021}}</ref> Jubilant Energy, a subsidiary of Jubilant Enpro, was awarded a 10% stake in the KG Deendayal gas discovery block in 2003.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Umarji |first1=Kalpana Pathak & Vinay |title=Jubilant Energy to exit GSPC block |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/jubilant-energy-to-exit-gspc-block-114071700157_1.html |website=Business Standard India |access-date=17 October 2021 |date=17 July 2014}}</ref>

===Jubilant MotorWorks===
Jubilant MotorWorks Private Limited was established in 2009. The company is an official dealer and partner for [[Audi]] in India.<ref>{{cite web |title=Audi India appoints Jubilant MotorWorks as its Mumbai South dealer - ET Auto |url=https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/aftermarket/audi-india-appoints-jubilant-motorworks-as-its-mumbai-south-dealer/77847976 |website=ETAuto.com |access-date=17 October 2021 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Audi India Announces Jubilant MotorWorks as Dealer Partner For South Mumbai and Nashik |url=https://www.news18.com/news/auto/audi-india-announces-jubilant-motoworks-as-dealer-partner-for-south-mumbai-and-nashik-2835943.html |website=News18 |access-date=17 October 2021 |language=en |date=1 September 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Audi India opens new service facility in Pune with Jubilant MotorWorks - ET Auto |url=https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/aftermarket/audi-india-opens-new-service-facility-in-pune-with-jubilant-motorworks/78536857 |website=ETAuto.com |access-date=17 October 2021 |language=en}}</ref> The company is also an official dealer MG Motors India and Porsche India.  

===Jubilant Consumer===
Jubilant Consumer Private Limited was established in 2013.
